segment.description: Bradley Creek, a Franklin/Coffee County stream near Tullahoma and Manchester that drains through AEDC Woods Reservoir into the Elk River system. Open to public fishing; not a stocked trout fishery (catalog).
segment.boundaries: Creek above Woods Reservoir. The USGS/TDEC gauged segment documented here is USGS-03578500 'BRADLEY CREEK NR PRAIRIE PLAINS, TN' (35.3563/-85.9790, Coffee County, HUC 06030003) - the upper creek upstream of the reservoir arm.

coldSource.notes: No documented cold-source mechanism. The creek's gauged temperature record (below) is nonetheless cool for the region, consistent with an upper-drainage creek on the Highland Rim margin, but no spring influence is documented in any source consulted.

holdover.detail: No holdover evidence exists - no trout are stocked in Bradley Creek (TWRA workbook has zero rows; TWRA trout regs do not list it), so there is no stocking program from which holdover could occur.

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout presence documented for Bradley Creek in TWRA or USGS sources consulted, despite the cool grab-sample regime. Absence of documentation, not documented absence.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: The gauged upper creek shows trout-viable temperatures year-round in the USGS/TDEC grab record (33 samples 1988-2020; Jun-Sep values 15.1-19.0 deg C, winter values 6.9-12.5 deg C), but no trout stocking program and no wild-trout documentation exist for the creek, so whether trout actually live there is undocumented.
